messages:
nora: Heads up 3 we have a break in onboarding caused by the new export map for the js-sdk. Starter apps (vite/next) + TS editors fail to resolve the package. Tagging @felix for bundler/resolver parity and @cam for packaging.

nora: Minimal repro:
1) create a fresh next app (TS)
2) yarn add @redwood/js-sdk@latest
3) import {createClient} from '@redwood/js-sdk' -> dev server crashes with resolver error and VSCode shows missing typings.

nora: The shipped package.json excerpt (v0.8.0):
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/js-sdk",
  "exports": {
    ".": {"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"},
    "./client": "./dist/esm/client.mjs",
    "./server": "./dist/cjs/server.cjs"
  }
}
```

nora: Errors seen:
- Vite: "Failed to resolve entry for package \"@redwood/js-sdk\". The package may have incorrect \"exports\" or \"module\" field."
- Bun: "Package \"@redwood/js-sdk\" does not have an entry point matching the import \"@redwood/js-sdk/client\"."
- VSCode: "Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/js-sdk'" even though we ship root types.

felix: This is the usual conditional exports + extension mismatch. Many bundlers want .js ESM files (not .mjs) and expect per-subpath conditionals. TS/tsserver will often try to load types per-export; root "types" alone can be ignored when exports are present.

cam: Short-term unblock: update examples to deep-import the ESM bundle: `import {createClient} from '@redwood/js-sdk/dist/esm/client.js'` and add a tsconfig path mapping so editors find the .d.ts during onboarding. We'll add this note to the starter README immediately.

cam: Hotfix plan: revert the strict .mjs/.cjs-only exports and publish a patch that:
- adds .js fallbacks for ESM & CJS (dist/esm/*.js, dist/cjs/*.js)
- makes per-subpath exports explicit with conditionals (`import` & `require`)
- includes `types` for each exported subpath (e.g., `"./client": { "types": "./dist/client.d.ts", ... }`)
- include `"./package.json": "./package.json"` in exports to help tools that need to read metadata.

felix: Also recommend we avoid wildcards. If we must add new subpaths, enumerate them in package.json. Wildcards cause inconsistent behaviour across Node, esbuild, vite, and bun.

nora: CI gap: examples smoke tests did not catch this because our release job only runs a node resolver check. We need a small matrix that runs `vite build`, `esbuild` resolution, and a Bun build against the examples before publishing.

cam: Agreed. I'll add a pre-publish job that runs a lightweight examples matrix (vite + bun + tsserver check) and a package-exports linter that validates `exports` against our canonical pattern. Fail the release if mismatch.

build-bot: Release guardian: examples smoke tests failed on preview. Blocking publish for v0.8.0.

felix: Extra gotcha: some consumers import `@redwood/js-sdk/client` while others use `@redwood/js-sdk/dist/esm/client.js`. Ensure both patterns are covered by exports and types so editors and bundlers are happy.

cam: I'll cut a revert PR now and push v0.8.1 with fixes. Follow-up: RFC to formalize export map policy across SDKs (explicit subpaths, per-export types, .js fallbacks, no wildcards). Also add a short dev checklist for packaging changes.

nora: Thanks. Once hotfix publishes we'll update starters and post a note in #general for anyone who hit the issue. :thumbsup:
